grammar:
root ::= sentence (" " sentence)? (" " sentence)?
sentence ::= first (" " word)* end
first ::= [A-Z] chars
word ::= [A-Za-z0-9$] chars
chars ::= ([A-Za-z0-9'@/&%$+-] | [.:,] [A-Za-z0-9])* ","?
end ::= "." | "!" | "?"
